accounts_auth_mapping_check.name: accounts_auth_mapping_check
accounts_auth_mapping_check.value: ("accounts"."auth_provider" in ('siwc', 'development') and "accounts"."auth_issuer" is null) or ("accounts"."auth_provider" = 'oidc' and "accounts"."auth_issuer" is not null and length("accounts"."auth_issuer") > 0)

billing_account_operation_leases_shape_c.name: billing_account_operation_leases_shape_check
billing_account_operation_leases_shape_c.value: ("billing_account_operation_leases"."state" = 'held' and "billing_account_operation_leases"."operation" is not null and "billing_account_operation_leases"."lease_token" is not null and "billing_account_operation_leases"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "billing_account_operation_leases"."last_acquired_at" is not null) or ("billing_account_operation_leases"."state" = 'idle' and "billing_account_operation_leases"."operation" is null and "billing_account_operation_leases"."lease_token" is null and "billing_account_operation_leases"."lease_expires_at" is null)

billing_checkout_attempts_session_state_.name: billing_checkout_attempts_session_state_check
billing_checkout_attempts_session_state_.value: "billing_checkout_attempts"."state" not in ('open', 'completed_pending_sync', 'completed') or "billing_checkout_attempts"."provider_session_id" is not null

billing_checkout_attempts_completed_chec.name: billing_checkout_attempts_completed_check
billing_checkout_attempts_completed_chec.value: ("billing_checkout_attempts"."state" = 'completed' and "billing_checkout_attempts"."completed_at" is not null) or ("billing_checkout_attempts"."state" <> 'completed' and "billing_checkout_attempts"."completed_at" is null)

billing_checkout_attempts_expired_check.name: billing_checkout_attempts_expired_check
billing_checkout_attempts_expired_check.value: ("billing_checkout_attempts"."state" = 'expired' and "billing_checkout_attempts"."expired_at" is not null) or ("billing_checkout_attempts"."state" <> 'expired' and "billing_checkout_attempts"."expired_at" is null)

billing_reconciliation_targets_exact_tar.name: billing_reconciliation_targets_exact_target_check
billing_reconciliation_targets_exact_tar.value: ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."subscription_id" is not null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."checkout_attempt_id" is null) or ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."subscription_id" is null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."checkout_attempt_id" is not null)

billing_reconciliation_targets_lease_che.name: billing_reconciliation_targets_lease_check
billing_reconciliation_targets_lease_che.value: ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" = 'processing' and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."lease_token" is not null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" <> 'processing' and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."lease_token" is null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."lease_expires_at" is null)

billing_reconciliation_targets_completio.name: billing_reconciliation_targets_completion_check
billing_reconciliation_targets_completio.value: ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" = 'processing' and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."last_completed_at" is null) or ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" <> 'processing' and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."last_completed_at" is not null)

billing_reconciliation_targets_error_che.name: billing_reconciliation_targets_error_check
billing_reconciliation_targets_error_che.value: ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" = 'failed' and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."last_error_code" is not null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."last_error_message" is not null) or ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" <> 'failed' and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."last_error_code" is null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."last_error_message" is null)

billing_reconciliation_targets_automatic.name: billing_reconciliation_targets_automatic_retry_check
billing_reconciliation_targets_automatic.value: ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" = 'failed' and (("billing_reconciliation_targets"."automatic_dead_lettered_at" is null and ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."next_automatic_attempt_at" is not null or "billing_reconciliation_targets"."automatic_failure_count" = 0)) or ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."automatic_dead_lettered_at" is not null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."automatic_failure_count" >= 8 and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."next_automatic_attempt_at" is null))) or ("billing_reconciliation_targets"."state" <> 'failed' and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."next_automatic_attempt_at" is null and "billing_reconciliation_targets"."automatic_dead_lettered_at" is null)

coaching_packages_price_check.name: coaching_packages_price_check
coaching_packages_price_check.value: ("coaching_packages"."price_amount_minor" is null and "coaching_packages"."currency" is null) or ("coaching_packages"."price_amount_minor" is not null and "coaching_packages"."price_amount_minor" >= 0 and "coaching_packages"."currency" is not null and length("coaching_packages"."currency") = 3)

consent_records_subject_reference_check.name: consent_records_subject_reference_check
consent_records_subject_reference_check.value: ("consent_records"."subject_type" = 'account' and "consent_records"."golfer_id" is null) or ("consent_records"."subject_type" = 'golfer' and "consent_records"."golfer_id" is not null)

consent_records_status_timestamp_consist.name: consent_records_status_timestamp_consistency_check
consent_records_status_timestamp_consist.value:
(
        "consent_records"."status" = 'granted'
        and "consent_records"."granted_at" is not null
        and "consent_records"."granted_at" <= "consent_records"."created_at"
        and "consent_records"."declined_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" is null
        and ("consent_records"."expires_at" is null or "consent_records"."expires_at" > "consent_records"."granted_at")
      ) or (
        "consent_records"."status" = 'declined'
        and "consent_records"."granted_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."declined_at" is not null
        and "consent_records"."declined_at" <= "consent_records"."created_at"
        and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."expires_at" is null
      ) or (
        "consent_records"."status" = 'withdrawn'
        and "consent_records"."granted_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."declined_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" is not null
        and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" <= "consent_records"."created_at"
        and "consent_records"."expires_at" is null
      ) or (
        "consent_records"."status" = 'expired'
        and "consent_records"."granted_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."declined_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."withdrawn_at" is null
        and "consent_records"."expires_at" is not null
        and "consent_records"."expires_at" <= "consent_records"."created_at"
      )

evidence_items_metric_check.name: evidence_items_metric_check
evidence_items_metric_check.value: ("evidence_items"."metric_value" is null and "evidence_items"."metric_name" is null and "evidence_items"."metric_unit" is null) or ("evidence_items"."metric_value" is not null and length(trim(coalesce("evidence_items"."metric_name", ''))) > 0)

instructor_profiles_accent_color_check.name: instructor_profiles_accent_color_check
instructor_profiles_accent_color_check.value: "instructor_profiles"."accent_color" is null or (length("instructor_profiles"."accent_color") = 7 and substr("instructor_profiles"."accent_color", 1, 1) = '#' and substr("instructor_profiles"."accent_color", 2) not glob '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*')

instructor_sessions_revocation_check.name: instructor_sessions_revocation_check
instructor_sessions_revocation_check.value: ("instructor_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "instructor_sessions"."revoke_reason" is null) or ("instructor_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and length(trim(coalesce("instructor_sessions"."revoke_reason", ''))) > 0)

media_assets_dimensions_check.name: media_assets_dimensions_check
media_assets_dimensions_check.value: ("media_assets"."width_pixels" is null or "media_assets"."width_pixels" > 0) and ("media_assets"."height_pixels" is null or "media_assets"."height_pixels" > 0) and ("media_assets"."duration_ms" is null or "media_assets"."duration_ms" >= 0)

scheduler_heartbeat_completion_check.name: scheduler_heartbeat_completion_check
scheduler_heartbeat_completion_check.value: ("scheduler_heartbeat"."state" = 'running' and "scheduler_heartbeat"."completed_at" is null) or ("scheduler_heartbeat"."state" <> 'running' and "scheduler_heartbeat"."completed_at" is not null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."completed_at" >= "scheduler_heartbeat"."started_at")

scheduler_heartbeat_result_shape_check.name: scheduler_heartbeat_result_shape_check
scheduler_heartbeat_result_shape_check.value: ("scheduler_heartbeat"."state" = 'succeeded' and "scheduler_heartbeat"."billing_configured" is not null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."considered_count" is not null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."attempted_count" is not null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."succeeded_count" is not null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."failed_count" is not null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."dead_letter_count" is not null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."last_failure_code" is null) or ("scheduler_heartbeat"."state" <> 'succeeded' and "scheduler_heartbeat"."billing_configured" is null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."considered_count" is null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."attempted_count" is null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."succeeded_count" is null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."failed_count" is null and "scheduler_heartbeat"."dead_letter_count" is null)

scheduler_heartbeat_failure_check.name: scheduler_heartbeat_failure_check
scheduler_heartbeat_failure_check.value: ("scheduler_heartbeat"."state" = 'failed' and "scheduler_heartbeat"."last_failure_code" is not null and length("scheduler_heartbeat"."last_failure_code") between 1 and 64 and "scheduler_heartbeat"."last_failure_code" not glob '*[^a-z0-9_]*') or ("scheduler_heartbeat"."state" <> 'failed' and "scheduler_heartbeat"."last_failure_code" is null)

scheduler_heartbeat_counts_check.name: scheduler_heartbeat_counts_check
scheduler_heartbeat_counts_check.value: "scheduler_heartbeat"."considered_count" is null or ("scheduler_heartbeat"."considered_count" >= 0 and "scheduler_heartbeat"."attempted_count" >= 0 and "scheduler_heartbeat"."succeeded_count" >= 0 and "scheduler_heartbeat"."failed_count" >= 0 and "scheduler_heartbeat"."dead_letter_count" >= 0 and "scheduler_heartbeat"."attempted_count" <= "scheduler_heartbeat"."considered_count" and "scheduler_heartbeat"."succeeded_count" + "scheduler_heartbeat"."failed_count" = "scheduler_heartbeat"."attempted_count")

share_sessions_revocation_check.name: share_sessions_revocation_check
share_sessions_revocation_check.value: ("share_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "share_sessions"."revoke_reason" is null) or ("share_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and length(trim(coalesce("share_sessions"."revoke_reason", ''))) > 0)
